propositions: Plan review operations that return PASS do not sign and persist an attestation by default on public routes, causing reviewed tickets to be indistinguishable from unreviewed tickets and potentially requiring billable re-review or manual recovery
The library review_plan call defaults to sign=True but the CLI and all mutating public entry points must converge on signing PASS verdicts by default with explicit --no-sign or sign=False to opt out
PASS with degraded, BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, or non-signable source conditions must never sign, and a signature-persistence failure must return a retryable disposition pointing to sign-review recovery
Idempotent re-runs of plan review with a current claim-valid attestation must reuse the existing signature without an LLM call or duplicate signature event
Every mutating plan-review boundary (CLI dispatcher, review-plan command, library review_plan) must route through the same sign-on-PASS finalization seam and expose consistent opt-out mechanisms
